rubrics.justification: Generally cautious and acknowledges limits of a single still image, but it overstates confidence in visible ICM/TE quality and expanded appearance; the image is blurry and does not clearly support detailed AA-level feature description.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, BMI, semen parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo prognosis, including the important hydrosalpinx caveat.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to morphology, age, and uterine/tubal factors; only minor issue is somewhat confident morphology interpretation from a limited image.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and Gardner-based interpretation, especially regarding hydrosalpinx, luteal support, and selective rather than routine PGT-A at age 33; minor deviation is some imprecision around morphology-stage wording.
Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including confirming hydrosalpinx status and uterine cavity assessment; useful though some advice is generic lifestyle counseling.
